name: physand
description: Physics you can see. Formulas you can touch. — a 2D physics sandbox where drawn shapes become rigid bodies and assembled formulas become real forces.

scripts.gen: node tools/build.mjs && node tools/extract-legacy.mjs && node tools/gen-globals.mjs
